ideas.pitch: A browser extension and mobile companion that intercepts social engineering attempts, analyzes suspicious emails and SMS, and provides instant risk breakdowns.
ideas.problem_statement: AI Scam Shield: Detect, Explain & Prevent Digital Scams
ideas.title: PhishGuard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the published problem statement with a tangible, user-facing artifact that judges can test immediately on their own devices.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-lingual SMS and WhatsApp scam detector built for regional languages to protect vulnerable demographics from fraudulent financial offers.
ideas.problem_statement: AI Scam Shield: Detect, Explain & Prevent Digital Scams
ideas.title: ScamSleuth SMS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success of Myth-Chaser by handling localized regional nuances, which appeals strongly to judges looking for local social impact.

ideas.pitch: An instant URL and QR code auditing tool that crawls deceptive websites, analyzes DOM structures with computer vision and LLMs, and flags phishing traps.
ideas.problem_statement: AI Scam Shield: Detect, Explain & Prevent Digital Scams
ideas.title: VeriSite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides clear, quantifiable risk scores and visual explanations that fulfill the hackathon's exact criteria for actionable guidance.

ideas.pitch: A conversational AI auditor where users can forward suspicious job offers or investment emails to receive a transparent, plain-language risk breakdown.
ideas.problem_statement: AI Scam Shield: Detect, Explain & Prevent Digital Scams
ideas.title: FraudExplain
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines prompt engineering creativity with consumer protection, aligning perfectly with the core focus of PromptWars.

ideas.pitch: A simplified accessibility-first assistant that sits on a senior citizen's phone to warn them before they interact with known fraudulent callers or links.
ideas.problem_statement: AI Scam Shield: Detect, Explain & Prevent Digital Scams
ideas.title: ElderShield AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven winning pattern of vulnerability-focused accessibility aids like GrandmaHelper and Haven to secure emotional resonance with judges.
